name: new-mail-summary
title: New mail summary
description: After each mail sync, sums up the new messages of each mailbox (Gmail or IMAP) and puts the summary in your Inbox.
notes: A run by hand or on a schedule has no mail-sync event: list your mailboxes in scheduledAccounts in the script first.

name: pr-review-rounds
title: PR review rounds
description: Twice a day on weekdays, opens a review session for each pull request updated since the last round; the findings come to you as asks.

name: jira-state-report
title: Jira state report
description: Every Monday, a report on your active Jira projects (synced, with an open issue assigned to you or reported by you): in progress, stuck, done and needing a decision, with a short version in your briefing.

name: team-performance-report
title: Team performance report
description: Every Friday, a report on the team's week from Jira, the people cards and Slack: what moved, what is stuck, who may need help.

name: release-buttons
title: Release and deploy buttons
description: Three workbench header buttons — Release, Deploy to test, Deploy to stage — that run your command and then a session that checks the result.
